text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to visit a shrine together with 
Phalaenopsis, 
who has been feeling somewhat out of 
sorts.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, Phaleno-san. ♪

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Grass? 
Are you here to pray as well?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was taking a walk nearby, so I 
thought 
I would offer a prayer before heading 
home.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Is something weighing on your mind, 
Phaleno-san? 
You had quite a serious look on your 
face...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
......— 
You are perceptive as ever.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to discern the direction of 
my heart. 
To determine where it ought to go.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The direction of your heart... 
I see.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I understand that 
sentiment. 
I, too, lose sight of my path from time to 
time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When that happens, though, there is 
something I like to suggest. ♪ 
Please take a look over there.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hm— 
Is that... a sacred arrow?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, precisely.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
An arrow flies straight and true. 
At an unwavering speed, in a single 
direction.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When I look upon its endlessly clear, pure 
flight, 
I feel as though the heading of my own 
heart 
naturally falls into place.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Toward where it ought to go, toward the 
path it must follow— 
righteously, at a steady pace.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Though, that is merely my own philosophy. 
♪

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Oho—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. As expected of you, Grass. 
I understand what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Such a serene, beautiful point. 
Wherever that arrow aims, it must surely 
lead toward good fortune.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall take one of those 
arrows with me. 
Let it guide my heart as well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... 
Such a keen arrowhead... Truly 
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Caw, caw!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh? 
A crow is—... My goodness!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hm, that is...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It is white... How extraordinary. ♪ 
If I recall correctly, a white crow is an 
omen of good fortune.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, so it is. 
...What an immaculate, pure white.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It feels as though fate has begun to flow 
in a favorable direction— 
You have my gratitude. 
...Arrow, and crow.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Now then...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: !? The arrowhead...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I-It completely came off... 
Let's go have them exchange it!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. Still, to think it would 
happen now... 
What an ill omen this is... Hmmm.
